# RealityGate

> RealityGate is an open-source, zero-dependency CLI, Claude Code plugin and GitHub Action that proves whether AI-generated ("vibe-coded") code is real. It gives any JavaScript/TypeScript or Python repository a Reality Score from 0 to 100, fails the build on stubs, placeholder code, fake data, hallucinated npm packages, leaked secrets and unvalidated API routes, proves its own checks can fail with planted canaries, and ships a spec-driven Build OS that takes vibe coders from idea to shipped MVP. MIT licensed, by Muhammad Usman.

Key facts:
- Install: `npx realitygate audit` (Node 20+), or the Claude Code plugin (`/plugin marketplace add usmanmanii/realitygate`), or the GitHub Action `usmanmanii/realitygate@v0.2.1`.
- Commands: `audit` (Reality Score + fix plan), `check` (build gate), `selftest` (proves every rule can fail), `proof` (Proof Ledger of verified tasks), `review-pack` (cross-model review bundle), `scan-skills` (read-only malware/red-flag scan of any skill or plugin before installing it), `agents install` (Codex/Gemini/Cursor/Copilot setup), `hooks install` (Claude Code guardrails), `init`, `doctor`.
- 16 built-in rules (R-001 to R-016): placeholder markers, stubs, placeholder copy, simulated implementations, fake data, unjustified ts-ignore/eslint-disable/any, console.log, commented-out code, hardcoded secrets, client-exposed secrets, swallowed errors, undeclared (hallucinated) imports, unvalidated routes, cross-module repository imports.
- Works with Claude Code (plugin, skills, hooks), OpenAI Codex and Antigravity/Gemini CLI (Agent Skills in `.agents/skills/` + AGENTS.md/GEMINI.md via `realitygate agents install`), Cursor (`.cursor/rules`), GitHub Copilot (`.github/copilot-instructions.md`), and any agent through a git pre-commit gate (`realitygate hooks install --git`).
- Runs locally, no network, no telemetry, never reads `.env` contents.

- [FAILURES](https://github.com/usmanmanii/realitygate/blob/main/FAILURES.md): catalogue of real ways AI-built code faked being done, and the rule that catches each
